headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an overall effect size of 0.74 (95% CI: 0.6–0.92), suggesting that black_cohosh is associated with a lower risk of breast cancer. However, this association should be interpreted with caution, as there was substantial between-study heterogeneity (I² = 64.24%), reflecting considerable variability across studies.
